name: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Ltd.
business_summary: Rural and semi-urban focused NBFC (Mahindra Group, M&M holds ~52.5%) financing utility/passenger vehicles, tractors, CVs, 3W, pre-owned vehicles, SME and housing (stake in Mahindra Rural Housing). Loan book ~Rs 1.3 lakh cr; Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 882-911 cr (+55% y/y, driven by lower credit cost and loan growth), NII +13%, PV disbursements +28%. The stock fell 10% on results day to a 52-week low after brokerages (Citi, Jefferies, Nomura) cut targets on margin pressure; -25.9% over three months.

cost_structure.note: interest Rs 9.4k cr of Rs 22.6k cr revenue

exposures.mechanism: Rural/semi-urban tractor, utility vehicle and pre-owned vehicle borrowers; +5pp rural demand growth -> disbursement +5pp, collection efficiency +1pt, credit cost -15bp -> PBT +9% x persistence 0.5 -> ~+4.5; haircut for leverage already priced (52w low) -> +4.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 PAT Rs 882 cr (+55%), NII +13%, revenue +15% (CNBC TV18/Business Standard)

exposures.mechanism: Tractor and UV demand plus collection cycles in farm-linked book (Stage 2/3 seasonally track harvest); +10% monsoon -> collection efficiency +1pt, tractor demand +3% -> +2.5.

PV disbursements +28% in Q2 (Autocar); portfolio is ~80% auto/utility/tractor/CV (model knowledge). +10% auto volumes -> disbursements +8%, NII +2.5%, credit cost -5bp -> PBT +5.5% x persistence 0.6 -> +3.3, +3.5 rounded.

~40% of borrowings are floating bank loans; assets largely fixed-rate; +25bp on ~Rs 48k cr = Rs 120 cr vs TTM financing profit Rs 5.2k cr = -2.3%; plus NCD repricing; pass-through low in competitive vehicle finance; persistence 0.6 -> -2.5 (incl. margin pressure noted by Citi/Jefferies).

evidence.note: Shares -10% to 52w low; Citi, Jefferies, Nomura cut targets on margin pressure (NDTV Profit/ET)

exposures.mechanism: +50bp on ~Rs 60k cr market borrowings repricing over 2 years: Rs 150 cr/yr = -3% PBT; sustained -> -3.5 with growth effect.

evidence.note: MMFS accepts bids for 3-year bonds (ET BFSI)

exposures.mechanism: Stage 3 ~3.5-4% (model knowledge, unverified); credit cost ~1.8-2.0%. +50bp on Rs ~1.3 lakh cr = Rs 650 cr = -12.5% of financing profit; persistence 0.5 -> -6.
Book is secured, but borrower base (rural/semi-urban SMEs, self-employed) shares cash-flow stress with unsecured cohort; indirect -1.5.

Diesel for CV/tractor/3W borrowers: +10% Brent -> +4% diesel cost, operating income -2% for transporters -> collection stress/demand for CV and utility vehicles; empirical -1.05/SSU (t -1.7) agrees. -1.0.
Empirical +1.61/SSU (t 1.7); rural wealth effect via gold prices supports demand; fundamental link weak -> +0.5.
Empirical +1.98/SSU (t 2.1): construction equipment and CV cycle; ~8% of book; cyclical co-movement shrunk to +0.8.
FIIs 9.95% (up from 9.40%); beta 1.4-1.6; stock -25.9% in 3m -> flow-sensitive; +1.5.
RBI scale-based NBFC norms, repossession/recovery rules and ECL framework transition; -2 expected.
GST cuts on small vehicles/tractors (Sept 2025 reform, model knowledge) lifted PV disbursements +28%; further consumption GST relief adds volume: +1.5.

company_links.mechanism: Per +10% move in M&M equity value: parent holds ~52.5% and drives ~30%+ of MMFS disbursements via Mahindra tractors/UVs (dominant partner). M&M tractor/UV demand news moves MMFS: +1.5 per +10% (assumed unit: % equity of dst per +10% of src).

supply_chain.note: 52.5% holder and captive-brand channel for UV/tractor finance

company_events.event: Dividend following 36th AGM approval on 4 Nov 2026 (record date unverified)
RBI MPC December: further hike adds to NIM pressure
Festive/rabi season collection efficiency print (Q3 business update)

current_state.trend: PAT Rs 882-911 cr (+55% y/y), revenue +15%, NII +13%; credit cost lower; but margin compression and slower NII growth than PAT growth
current_state.valuation: P/E 10.8, P/B ~1.45 (Rs 288 vs BV 198), dividend yield 2.6%; at 52w low (253-415 range); ICICI Securities target Rs 415, others cut
recent_developments: 2026-10-22: stock -10% on margin worries; Citi, Jefferies, Nomura cut targets (NDTV Profit, ET)

key_risks: Margin compression from funding cost and competitive pricing
Rural stress (monsoon, farm incomes) and Stage 3 relapse
